title: buildzr built workspace record (build.json)
description: <build output>/<name>/build.json: how a workspace was built, from which model file, and whether it is ok or broken. A broken workspace has the stage it failed at and its errors; with stage 'check' its data/ folder is there, with 'model' or 'layout' it is not.

buildzr.description: The version of buildzr that built it.

elkjs.description: The version of the ELK layout engine, or null when the layout stage is not installed.

modelHash.description: The modelHash of data/index.json. Only when data/ is there.

name.description: The folder name, and the address /<name>/ of buildzr serve.

workspace.description: The name of the Workspace in Python.

workspaces.description: The names of every built workspace the model file made in this build.

file.description: The model file, relative to the workspaces folder (for a workspaces: list, to the folder of buildzr.yaml), with / separators.

fingerprint.description: Decides whether the built workspace is up to date; the same for an ok and a broken build of the same input.

workspacesFolder.description: The workspaces folder, relative to the build output, with / separators. For a workspaces: list, the folder of buildzr.yaml.

workspacesList.description: Only when the workspace was built from a workspaces: list: the config file holding the list, relative to the build output. A build removes only the workspaces it built itself: the same folder, and the same list or none.

stage.description: Broken only: the step that failed.

errors.description: Broken only: what went wrong, at most 50 errors of at most 500 characters.
